Record Class Measures

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
network.ike.tooling.buildreport.Measures
Record Components:
values - the session's measures, in collection order
modules - per-module measures, keyed by module artifact id and then by measure key
slowest - the slowest test classes, slowest first
notes - what could not be measured and why, one line each
public record Measures(Map<String,Double> values, Map<String, Map<String,Double>> modules, List<Measures.SlowSuite> slowest, List<String> notes) extends Record
What one session was like, in numbers (ike-issues#1207): warnings by kind, tests, coverage, time, sizes, and whatever measurements its tests left behind.

Values are keyed by MeasureKey.key() for the measures the extension derives itself, and by the names the ledger or a test chose for the rest. A quantity the session could not measure is absent, never zero: a build that ran no tests has no tests.run, so a bound on it is reported as not measured rather than tripped.
